data.title: Reade Heredia gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.description: Appalling service - white glove delivery anything but
data.content:
We placed an order for a bed on March 30. The bed was delivered damaged on April 16. We refused delivery of the damaged piece at the direction of the "White Glove" delivery company. We were told by the delivery company they would take the damaged piece and replace it the following week. We did not hear back from them so we reached out to Lulu and Georgia and were told we should have sent the whole bed back and the earliest we could receive our bed was May 13th. That is one and a half months from the original order date. We were upset about this, but felt like we did not have any other options.

Today is May 15th, and we still don't have our bed. We contacted the delivery company to determine why our bed was never delivered on the scheduled date, and they have given us no answer, except that they can't deliver now until the week of May 25th. That is two months from the original order date.

This is absolutely appalling service from both Lulu and Georgia and this "White Glove" delivery service. I'm beginning to wonder if the (mandatory) delivery service included with our order is a scam. I'm shocked at this level of support from what we thought was a reputable company. I would like to cancel this order and receive a refund. Please let me know as soon as possible how this can be resolved.
